props.text: Three permanent advantages of the eastern basin

props.html: Protected municipal quay zoning preserves sightlines, calm traffic-free evenings, and year-round water access outside every archway.
Entrepotdok terminates at Kadijksplein with bollards restricting cut-through vehicles, leaving mornings calm for walkers and cyclists.
Step down from indoor bike workshops to the twenty-eight e-cargo chargers or launch straight onto calm basin water toward Amstel locks.
Centuries-old plane trees and zoo botanical lawns sit directly opposite the south windows with no scheduled high-rise development parcels.

props.text: 1894 Flemish-bond brick meets Austrian CLT spruce.

props.html: Every historic load-bearing masonry pier stays untouched while dry-jointed cross-laminated spruce mezzanines insert warm habitable volume cleanly inside.

props.text: From 1894 brick warehouse shell to timber-lined loft

props.beforeAlt: Restored Flemish-bond red-brick facade with tall vertical steel windows

props.html: Shared closed-loop canal heat exchange supplies radiant floor loops year-round without fossil gas.
Dry-bolted seven-ply Austrian spruce decks carry zero curing moisture into heritage walls.
Thermally broken narrow-profile steel frames fitted with 0.6 W/m²K triple acoustic glass.
Engineered with Monumentenzorg Amsterdam to sequester carbon inside dry timber inserts while keeping the 1894 envelope breathable.

items.a: Interior Flemish-bond masonry is cleaned with low-pressure mist, repointed in hydraulic lime mortar, and backed with 80 mm breathable wood-fibre insulation to prevent condensation behind heritage brick.
Factory-milled 240 mm cross-laminated spruce decks drop through the former grain-hoist roof hatch and hang from galvanized steel ledger angles without cutting new pockets into historic piers.
items.q: Phase 02 · Craning dry CLT spruce mezzanine cassettes

items.a: Titanium plate heat exchangers submerged beneath the kayak pontoon harvest steady thermal energy from the Entrepotdok water column, feeding ultra-low-temperature screed loops.
Wide-plank smoked oak boards, unlacquered brass hardware, and VOC-free silicate mineral paints ensure healthy indoor air quality from day one.
